strengths: Simple peeking/reveal mechanic creates immediate visual intrigue in the first seconds.
Easily translates to King Robert spying on a royal crisis or ruined room.
concerns: Original cultural/event context needs to be stripped away and replaced with castle narrative elements.
adaptation_idea: King Robert peeks from behind a velvet royal curtain to reveal a messy or flooded throne room, immediately prompting the player to solve a puzzle and restore the castle.
